diagnosis.original_evidence: Original SHA-pinned D3A5/C980/C993 source draws the central sun 0x570002 while CABE draws independent surrounding discs; R84 R30/R33 already validates original raw WVP and post-LEFT source identity.
source_trace: R30HasExactLensCentreRawWvp requires a matching original C993 invocation, pose epoch, live shader and original game-c64 writer before per-eye matrices are computed.

R33TryHud and R30 screen-space eye path originally validate before and after LEFT but then invoke RIGHT render-target, depth, viewport and c64 setters before submitting RIGHT without another physical owner check.

RIGHT state setters can synchronously reenter original callbacks; the newly added predicate compares accepted LEFT and pending RIGHT source/serial/shader/pose and the existing failure path restores RT/depth/original c64.
diagnosis.root_cause: A time-of-check/time-of-use hole between the post-LEFT exact C993 provenance test and physical RIGHT Draw allowed reentrant GPU state setter callbacks to change the original lens owner or raw c64 source after the stereo source was accepted.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally flatten all alpha/flare primitives into screen HUD, duplicate original LEFT or alter CABE outer discs to hide a centre owner problem.
Do not invent new disparity heuristics, change GPU scene depth for SkyGlow, or disable the original game's one-draw fallback when source is unproven.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R30 and R33 now check the shared compile-time-enforced SameCentreForRightEye fence after RIGHT RT/depth/viewport/c64 setters and before each actualDraw.
